published_ranges._notes: Official page: break-away high-temp support for ThermaX PEKK, PEEK, PEI (ULTEM), PPSU, PSU, PPS; SKU SUP07UN200500NAT0; 500g and 1kg reels. Bed range beyond 'up to 160C' not published; hub lists no TDS for HTS1 (SDS only). Diameter tolerance not published. Beyond X1/P1/P2S. Earlier entry: Values from MatterHackers listing 'ThermaX HTS High Temp Support' (out of stock); official page unreachable (HTTP 429). Break-away support for PEEK, PEKK and Ultem. Bed temps up to 160C; heated chamber required for best results (max 225C). Beyond Bambu Lab printer nozzle limits.
